name: ARMCL_Function_Business_agent
business: Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) manufacturing, sales and delivery; Asphalt
scope: Function-based view of ARMCL operations: business functions, activities, owners, rules, KPIs, and data sources across the full value chain
source: downloads/19_Akij_Readymix_Policy.docx (Doc ARL/ARMCL-03/Factory/Dept/03/03); downloads/20_SOP_Production.docx; downloads/13_JD_ARMCL_Employees.xlsx; downloads/17_ARMCL-03_OEE_New_Template.csv; downloads/01_Budget_2026-27.xlsx; ARMCL Reference Documents master list

functions.purpose: Set annual budget, 5-year roadmap, monthly targets and track SBU performance
activities: Annual budget preparation (IS, BS, Cash Flow, BEP, COGS, Opex, Working Capital, VAT, Depreciation)
5-year strategy plan maintenance
Monthly sales and production target setting by plant and team
Trend analysis: daily actual delivery vs target with deviation tracking
MIS dashboards and performance reviews for EXCOM/ManCom/Board
functions.owner: CEO, Manager - Planning & Business Operations, Head of Sales
rules: 100% sales target is the mandatory baseline
Collection target minimum qualifying level: 90%
Budget variance reviewed via iBOS internal-control reports

functions.purpose: Achieve sales targets through teams A/B/C/CTG, market visits, pricing and credit proposals
activities: Customer acquisition, order booking and target tracking (employee-level ADS/RADS)
Market visits per standard format
Pricing, discount, credit days and credit limit proposals per delegation matrix
Collection follow-up and customer statement reconciliation
functions.owner: Head of Sales, Managers, Dy/Asst Managers, Sr. Officers, Officers (Teams A/B/C/CTG)
rules: Detailed sales process rules (KYC, pricing/credit delegation, incentives, complaints, bad debt) are owned by the ABSL Function Business agent - see ABSL_Function_Business_agent.json
FY 2025-26: grand target 12,145,000 CUM, sales 10,865,608 CUM, achievement 89.47%

functions.purpose: Plan and execute concrete batching per casting schedule with maximum efficiency and mix consistency
activities: Casting schedule / lifting plan entry and execution
Shift-wise batching (Shift A/B, 720 min shift time, capacity ~1,440 CUM/shift at ARMCL-03 HZS-120)
OEE tracking: availability, performance, quality
Downtime logging (planned vs unplanned/NPT) and wastage tracking
Daily production reporting (CUM and CFT)
functions.owner: Factory Incharge, Production Engineer, Batching Plant Operator, Wheel Loader Operator
rules: Only authorized personnel may operate or adjust the batching system
Only trained personnel may operate equipment; regular training and supervision mandatory
Operations must stop immediately if unsafe conditions are identified
All operational, quality, and maintenance records must be maintained and archived for audits
Production team must be informed by maintenance team when problems arise during running production

functions.purpose: Ensure consistent quality of raw materials and ready-mix concrete per approved mix designs and project requirements
activities: Raw material testing before use (cement, aggregates, water, admixtures)
Slump and cube testing during production
Monitoring plant operations for quality consistency during batching
Quality adjustments coordination with plant operator and plant in-charge
Daily/weekly/monthly quality reports and QMS procedures
Liaison with production, procurement, and site teams
Site visits by Production Engineer to align production with ground requirements
functions.owner: Quality Control Engineer (reports to Quality Head; team: Sub Assistant Engineer, Quality Supervisor, Quality Technician)
rules: Design changes may be implemented per client demand, weather, road & site conditions subject to approval by QC Head & Operation Head

Material rejection: QC and Distribution Team must provide documented proof and corrective solution; pre-approval by QC Head, Logistics & Distribution Incharge, Inventory Incharge & Plant Head; final approval by SBU Head

functions.purpose: Keep batching plant and equipment available through preventive and running maintenance
activities: Preventive maintenance per schedule
Running maintenance coordination with production team
Equipment inspection and housekeeping by operators
Reporting equipment issues promptly (wheel loader, batching plant)
functions.owner: Maintenance Head / Maintenance team, Factory Incharge
rules: Equipment must follow scheduled preventive maintenance
Operations must stop immediately if unsafe conditions are identified
Maintenance team informs production team of issues created during running production

functions.purpose: Deliver the right quantity and quality of concrete to site on time via lifting plans and transit mixers
activities: Lifting plan entry and casting schedule alignment
Transit mixture (TM) dispatch and in-transit quality preservation
Site delivery and confirmation
Handling site complaints: delay, quality issue, short supply
functions.owner: Logistic Supervisor, Transit Mixture Drivers, Distribution Team
rules: Ensure correct quantity & quality delivery at site
Site complaints (delay, quality, short supply) handled per Logistic Supervisor SOP
Concrete quality preservation during transit is a KPI of the logistics function

functions.purpose: Manage P&L, balance sheet, receivables, VAT and working capital for the SBU
activities: Income statement and balance sheet preparation with budget variance
Customer statement reconciliation
Collection follow-up and receivable posting (incl. customer cheque deposit process)
VAT, depreciation, interest and source-of-fund tracking
Working capital and cash flow monitoring
functions.owner: Finance Officer, Finance & Accounts Head, CFO (ABSL)
rules: Cheque deposit & receivable posting must follow SOP_Customer Cheque Deposit & Receivable Posting Process
Overdue beyond 60 days triggers automatic credit hold (per Sales SOP)
Adjustments/write-offs require documented approval per authority matrix
data_sources: downloads/01_Budget_2026-27.xlsx (IS, BS, CF, Working Capital, VAT)
downloads/10_SOP_and_Policy/Copy of SOP_Customer Cheque Deposit & Receivable Posting Process (1).pdf

functions.purpose: Monitor and reduce production and operating costs, including fuel (diesel) consumption
activities: Cost controlling analysis by plant/cost head
Diesel consumption tracking for fleet and equipment
Opex monitoring against budget (GL-level)
Break-even (BEP) and COGS analysis
functions.owner: Factory Incharge, Finance & Accounts, Manager - Planning & Business Operations
rules: Cost efficiency is a core competency for all plant roles
Opex tracked at GL level against budget in the BEP module

functions.purpose: Manpower planning, job descriptions, performance management, and administrative support
activities: JD maintenance for all ARMCL employees (15 role templates)
Sales manpower organogram and team structuring (A/B/C/CTG)
HRBP support to business units: strategy alignment, training, supervision
Office administration, security, and housekeeping
functions.owner: HRBP (Officer/Sr. Officer/Asst. Manager), Admin Officer, Security Guard, CEO
rules: Only trained personnel may operate equipment; regular training mandatory for all key roles
PPE is mandatory for all staff; safety protocols must be followed
All key roles require documented JDs and organogram alignment

functions.purpose: Ensure personnel and equipment safety and minimize environmental impact of plant operations
activities: PPE enforcement and safety protocol compliance
Dust and emissions control
Safety checks by wheel loader and plant operators
Immediate stop of operations on unsafe conditions
functions.owner: Factory Incharge, Plant In-Charge, all operational staff
rules: PPE is mandatory for all staff
Environmental controls (dust, emissions) must be actively managed
Operations must stop immediately if unsafe conditions are identified

functions.purpose: Maintain SOPs, policies, authority delegation, and audit trail across the SBU
activities: SOP & policy maintenance (production policy doc ARL/ARMCL-03/Factory/Dept/03/03, effective 01-07-2025, review 01-07-27)
Authority matrix enforcement for approvals
Price, credit days, credit limit approvals for new customers
Cash incentives & promotional gifts approvals for referral sales
Documentation and record keeping for audits
functions.owner: CEO, SBU Head, Internal Audit, Department Heads
rules: All operational, quality, and maintenance records must be archived and available for audits
Approvals follow ARMCL Authority_Matrix_SOP (Final Draft)
Production policy prepared by Md. Saddam Hossain Tuhin (Plant In-Charge, Unit 03), approved by Md. Anisur Rahman (CEO, ABSL)
